game_title: Flowchart Lab · Count up to n
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Unit Trader: Convert units using expressions so each trade of fire gems is fair.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Print the whole numbers from 1 through n. If n is zero, print nothing. Test dataset 9: {'n': 0}; {'n': 14}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Unit Trader' (Week 2 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Obsidian Quarry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Protect the ember furnace from smoke serpents in Obsidian Quarry: keep the fair_trades meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: fair_trades drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
